Title: Sanjay's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Sanjay - 28 years, son
Look: white kurta-pyjama
2. Sonali - 56 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Hema - 28 years, daughter
Look: red salwar-kameez
4. Vinod - 32 years, friend
Look: light beard, green T-shirt

Places

1. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights

Scene 1: The main road - Day

[Sanjay stands on the road. Vinod stands near him.]

Vinod: "Sanjay, what's the plan today?"

[Sanjay's bike skids on the wet road and he falls off.]

Sanjay: "Vinod, listen!"

[Sanjay's car crashes into a pole.]

Vinod: "And then?"

[A dog runs in front of Sanjay's car; he brakes hard and swerves just in time.]

Sanjay: "That's great!"

[Sanjay loses his balance on the bicycle and falls.]

Sanjay: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
